# Setup responsibilities

For stored-password setup commands on macOS and Linux, follow [administrator commands](administrator-commands.md).

Agents do every setup step software can do, including system settings such as
macOS permission prompts. The operator is needed only for steps software
physically cannot complete: a browser sign-in such as Google sign-in, and any
permission the OS refuses to let software grant. Passwords are entered only by
product code from stored secrets, never typed by hand.
